title: VERDICT case package v1
description: Everything a JudgeRouter case is opened from. Canonicalised (sorted keys, UTF-8, no insignificant whitespace, integers only: an RFC 8785 subset) and hashed with SHA-256; that hex digest is the case's receipt number (packageDigest). EVERYTHING IN THIS OBJECT IS PUBLISHED ON-CHAIN, permanently. Key sets are closed (additionalProperties: false) so no IP, token, API key or email can ride along. Mirrored by contracts/judge_router.py `_verify_package` and relayer/src/lib/package.ts `verifyPackage`.

requestKey.description: Idempotency key. Sent on-chain as the client_ref; the contract returns the existing case for a resubmit with the same digest and reverts for a different one.

caseId.description: Always null: the on-chain id does not exist until open_case_package runs.

attempt.description: Bumped only when an operator deliberately files a NEW requestKey for the same dispute. Retries reuse the outbox bytes unchanged.

rubric.description: Preset key (whos_right, better_roast, pettiest_text, better_comeback) or custom text.

text.description: Already sanitised: NFKC, zero-width/bidi and control characters removed, trimmed. sanitise(text) must equal text.

sha256.description: sha256(UTF-8 bytes of text), lowercase hex.

entrySource.description: Fixed by surface: settle -> participant_submitted, live -> host_submitted, api -> api_client_submitted.

assurance.description: verified_participant only when a side-token holder submitted this entry (participant_submitted only). It is the relayer's claim; the chain cannot check it.

consent.description: Exactly boolean true: the submitter agreed that entries become public, permanent on-chain data that cannot be erased.

contractAddress.description: The contract checks this equals its own address (no cross-deployment replay).

contractCodeDigest.description: sha256 of the contract source the relayer pinned. Recorded; the contract cannot check its own code.

submissionDeadline.description: open_case_package reverts (expired) after this tx time.

appealWindowExpiry.description: No judge/appeal after this; a still-pending case can then be expired to stale. Must be after submissionDeadline and at most 30 days later.
